transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I... well, my family made me come. I keep telling them... I'm the reason my friend passed away. I didn't call her back when I should have. I had... ugly thoughts sometimes. And now... I just know the Lord is punishing everybody at our church because of what I did. I'm just... I'm the reason.
Do you feel guilty about not calling your friend back?

Yes. I... I already said that. It's my fault she died. If I had just picked up the phone... but I didn't. And I had those terrible thoughts. I deserve it... but it's not fair that God is punishing the whole congregation for my sins. It's all because of me.
Do you often have thoughts that you can't stop thinking about?
I... I don't know what you mean by that. I just... I think about what I did. That's all.
Are these thoughts about your friend and what you did something that you think about all the time?
I don't... I'm not sure. I haven't really noticed if it's all the time. It's just... they're just there.
Do you feel like you have to think about what happened to your friend?
I don't... I don't know about having to. It's not like that. It's just... it's just what's in my head.
Do you feel like you have to do anything to make these thoughts go away?
No... I don't do anything. There's nothing you can really do anyway. I just... I just sit there.
Do you feel like you have to repeat certain actions over and over?
No... I don't think so. I don't really do much of anything at all.
Have you been feeling sad most of the time lately?
I don't know... I'm not really sure if it's sadness. I just... I don't really feel much of anything lately. It's all just sort of heavy.
Have you been feeling unhappy lately?
I don't know... I suppose. I don't really think about it like that. I'm not happy, but... it's mostly just like I said. I'm just sort of... here.
Do you feel hopeless?
I don't know... I don't really think about the future much anymore. So I couldn't really say. It's just... all kind of blank, I suppose.
Is feeling guilty the main thing you've been feeling lately?

I suppose... yes. It's just... I know it's my fault. My friend passed away, and... I didn't call her back. I should have. And sometimes I had... ugly thoughts. Now I know the Lord is punishing everyone at the church because of what I did. It's just... heavy.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy?

I suppose so. I just... I don't go to choir anymore. Or the knitting circle, or bingo. I used to like walking through Patterson Park, but... I don't know. I just sit in my chair now. None of it really feels worth getting dressed for.
Do you feel like you need to do something to make up for what happened to your friend?
I don't... no. I don't think there's anything I can do. It's too late for that, I suppose. So... no.
Do you find yourself constantly thinking about what you could have done differently to prevent your friend's death?
I try not to. It just... comes up. But I don't want to talk about that part anymore.
Do you feel like you have to pray or perform any rituals to try and make things right with God?
No. I don't... I don't do anything like that.
Do you find yourself thinking about your friend's death over and over again?
I mean... sometimes. But I'd rather just leave it at that.
Is your guilt about not calling your friend back stopping you from doing things you need to do?

I suppose... yes. I've missed some shifts at work. And I guess I've made some mistakes at the register... enough that my supervisor got worried about me. My niece, too. I just... I don't do much at home either. The bills are just piling up unopened. And I haven't been going to my church groups or visiting anyone anymore. I just... stay away.
Do you feel like you have to do something specific to try to get rid of your guilty feelings?
No. I don't... there's nothing I can really do about it anyway.
Has your feeling of guilt about not calling your friend back been affecting your relationships with family or friends?
I don't really know. I just... like I said, I don't see people much right now. I'd rather just be by myself.
Do you feel guilty all the time?
I'm not really sure. I... I don't really keep track of it like that.
